MENU_QUICK_DESC: Any two sides, any ground. Play now.
MENU_CUP_DESC: The nations' world championship, or the national championship of the states.
MENU_WATCH_DESC: Two AI sides play it out. See how it is done.
FORMAT_CLASSIC_DESC: The national federation's game: nine a side, eight seated in the lane, 27 m field, 1 point an out, the follow-on.
FORMAT_FAST_DESC: The seven-a-side game of the 2025 world championship and the franchise league: 22 m field, 2 points an out, dream runs, the wazir and the power play.
TURN_NOTE: A match is four turns: each side chases twice and defends twice.
V_MAIDAN_DESC: Beaten earth at dusk, the village sitting round the ropes.
V_SCHOOL_DESC: Morning on the school's earth field.
V_ARENA_DESC: On mats under the lights, as the fast game is played.
V_FLOODLIT_DESC: Red earth under floodlights, the stands full.
DIFF_BEGINNER_DESC: The other side is slower to read the chase and to rise.
DIFF_CLUB_DESC: A fair match for a new player.
DIFF_STATE_DESC: The sides play as their ratings say.
DIFF_INTERNATIONAL_DESC: Quicker, sharper and with fewer fouls than you.
FOLLOW_ON_NOTE: You lead by {n} or more after the first innings. Make them chase again now: if they are still behind after it, you win without your second chase.
LANE_ASSIST_NOTE: On: your active chaser keeps to his direction and his side of the lane, so you only foul with a late kho. Off: turn back or cross the lane and the umpire whistles.
GFX_AUTO: Lower it by itself if a match runs slowly
GFX_NOTE: Low suits older and smaller phones: no outlines, a thinner crowd, a lower render scale.
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: About {n} frames a second, drawn at 80%: the phone stays cooler and the battery lasts.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: {n} frames a second on a {hz} Hz screen.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: As many as the screen shows ({hz} a second). Uses the most battery.
MOVE_BUTTONS_NOTE: Drag a button where your thumb finds it. Each is kept where you leave it.
ABOUT_DISCLAIMER: Every player is invented. No real player, club, league, competition or federation is named or shown. The game collects no data and needs no internet.
LICENCES_INTRO: What the game is made with, and the licences that let it be shared.
RULES_FIELD_TEXT: A rectangle 27 m by 16 m (22 m in the fast game). Down the middle runs the central lane, 30 cm wide, from one pole to the other. Eight cross lanes (six in the fast game) cross it, making the squares the chasers sit in. Behind each pole is a free zone.
RULES_SIDES_TEXT: The chasing side sits in the squares, each facing the other way from the one beside him, with one active chaser on his feet. The defending side comes on three at a time, a batch, and tries to stay in.
RULES_KHO_TEXT: Only the active chaser may chase. To pass the chase on he touches a seated chaser on the back with his palm and calls "kho!". That chaser rises and is the active chaser; the giver sits in his square. A seated chaser must not rise before the kho.
RULES_DIRECTION_TEXT: The active chaser must keep going toward the pole he first set off for. He may not turn back, and may not cross the central lane, except by going round a pole through the free zone. He must give a kho before he has passed that chaser's cross lane.
RULES_OUTS_TEXT: A defender is out when the active chaser touches him with his hand, when he goes out of the field's limits, or when he comes on late. When all three of a batch are out the next batch comes on at once.
RULES_FOULS_TEXT: Turning back, crossing the lane, a late kho, rising early: the umpire whistles, and keeps whistling until the chaser puts it right. A defender touched during a foul is not out.
RULES_TURNS_TEXT: A match is two innings; in each, each side chases for one turn and defends for one. The chasers score a point for every defender out (2 in the fast game). The side with more points after four turns wins.
RULES_FOLLOW_ON_TEXT: In the classic game a side 9 or more ahead after the first innings may make the other chase again at once. A tied knockout match goes to an extra innings, then to minimum chases: the quicker first out wins.
RULES_FAST_TEXT: Seven chasers, six seated. Each side's wazir may run either way. A batch that stays on three minutes scores a dream run point, and another every 30 seconds. Once a turn the chasers may call a power play: two wazirs until that batch is out.
RULES_OFFICIALS_TEXT: Two umpires, one for each half, move along the side lines. A short whistle and a raised arm: out. Short whistles again and again with an arm pointing the way: a foul. The timekeeper starts and ends each turn; the referee runs the match.
CTRL_CHASE_TEXT: When your side chases you are always the active chaser. Your left thumb, anywhere on the left, is the joystick. Touch a defender and he is out.
CTRL_KHO_TEXT: Run up behind a seated chaser who faces the other side: his square lights up. Press KHO and you become him, rising on the other side of the lane. Too late and it is a foul.
CTRL_DIVE_TEXT: DIVE throws you full length at the nearest defender: it reaches further, but you are down for a moment if you miss.
CTRL_POLE_TEXT: Run into the free zone to turn: round the pole you may come out either way, on either side. DIVE there is a pole dive, one hand on the pole.
CTRL_DEFEND_TEXT: When your side defends you run one of the batch; SWITCH takes another. DODGE is a quick burst. Stay behind the active chaser: he cannot turn back. Keep inside the lines.
CTRL_ASSIST_TEXT: With the lane assist on (Settings) your chaser will not turn back or cross the lane by mistake. Turn it off to play every rule yourself.
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD or the arrows to run, Space for the first button, J and K for the others, Esc to pause.
MOVE_CHAIN_TEXT: Defenders zig-zag round the seated chasers from one side of the lane to the other, so each kho comes a step late.
MOVE_RING_TEXT: A defender circles in the open field, far from the seated chasers who face him, always behind the active chaser's back.
MOVE_KHO_CHAIN_TEXT: Good chasers pass the chase quickly along the lane, each kho to the chaser nearest the defender, until one rises at his shoulder.
MOVE_SKY_DIVE_TEXT: A full-length leap to touch a defender just out of reach, often at the lines.
MOVE_POLE_DIVE_TEXT: One hand on the pole, the chaser swings out past it and stretches for the defender beyond.
MOVE_WAZIR_TEXT: In the fast game, the one chaser who may change direction. Sides keep him for the trickiest defender.
MOVE_DREAM_TEXT: A batch that survives three minutes in the fast game wins its side a point, and another every 30 seconds after.
CUP_WORLD_DESC: Sixteen nations in four groups of four, then the quarter-finals, semi-finals and the final. Played to the fast rules.
CUP_NATIONAL_DESC: Sixteen states in four groups, then the knockouts. Played to the classic rules.
CUP_OUT: Your side is out of the championship.
CUP_ABANDON_Q: Start a new championship? This one will be lost.
REC_NONE: Play a match to start the record book.
